Content: . . . Prussia’s borders according to the Vienna Treaties [of `1814–15`] are not favorable for a healthy, vital state; it is not by speeches and majority resolutions that the great questions of the time are decided – that was the big mistake of `1848` and `1849` – but by iron and blood. . . .
